newsitem.title: UK: British Telecom up on German licence news.
newsitem.headline: British Telecom up on German licence news.

text.p: Shares in British Telecom Plc rose on Tuesday as investors were cheered by news the company had won Germany's fourth mobile telecommunications licence, traders said.
The stock was up 7p at 432-1/2 by 1250 GMT with volume of around 12.4 million shares.
The German government announced on Tuesday that the E2 Mobilfunk GmbH consortium -- jointly owned by BT and German utility group Viag AG -- had been awarded the licence.
"If they roll out their network really quickly, they could make a real go of this," said Jim McCafferty, telecoms analyst at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett.
The consortium can begin construction of the network immediately and it must make its services available to at least 75 percent of the population by the end of 2001.
